limitations: LCP is the final candidate after the load event plus a fixed 2000 ms observation window, before any catalog or search input.

Usability timestamps are the first animation frame containing the real visible control with application prerequisites; functionality is independently exercised after the first-screen metrics are captured.
Local identity/no-store HTTP transport is matched across phases; these are not a CDN or production-host benchmark.
CDP wire encodedDataLength includes protocol headers; Resource Timing encodedBodySize and decodedBodySize are also recorded separately.
completionMeaning: complete means all five measurements captured real LCP, navigation and functional title/directory timings. success separately requires no observed network failure or page error.
auxiliaryFailureScope: All five runs observed the old assistant status request failing CORS from measurement origin http://127.0.0.1:8766. The original 8755 origin was not retested; no production availability inference is made.
inventoryNote: The original freeze parser retained one commented example script path as missing with zero bytes; it never generated a Chrome request and does not affect the 18,436,693-byte JS total. Actual local HTTP requests all returned 200.

priorInvalidAttempt.reason: CDP Page domain was not enabled before the preload instrumentation; the real page loaded but no timing observer data was captured. The attempt was aborted, preserved, and the observer was verified before the declared five-run baseline.
